name: Yuvomi
description: Yuvomi is a private, self-hosted family planner — one calm home for everything your household needs to stay organized. No cloud accounts, no subscriptions, no tracking: your data lives on your server and nowhere else. Independent modules — turn on what fits, ignore the rest: - Dashboard — today's tasks, events, meals and reminders at a glance - Tasks — shared to-dos with priorities, due dates and assignees - Shopping — collaborative grocery lists, auto-sorted by category - Meals & Recipes — weekly meal planner with a built-in recipe book - Calendar — family calendar with recurring events and reminders - Budget — shared expenses, split costs and a spending overview - Housekeeping — chores, supplies and staff/session tracking - Documents — store and find important household files - Notes, Contacts & Birthdays — everything else in one tidy place Why Yuvomi: - Mobile-first PWA — install it on any phone, works offline - Light & dark mode, fast and polished (no bloated frameworks, no build step) - Optional sync — CalDAV / CardDAV, Apple and Google Calendar - OIDC single sign-on for households that already run an identity provider - Encrypted-at-rest storage (SQLCipher) with automated, scheduled backups - Multi-language, fully self-contained and MIT-licensed — Setup — REQUIRED: Set a long random SESSION_SECRET. RECOMMENDED:/b> Set a strong DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY to encrypt the database at rest — without it the database and any synced calendar/contact credentials are stored unencrypted. Generate either secret with: openssl rand -base64 48 After the container starts, open the WebUI — the first visit guides you through creating your admin account. (Headless setups can alternatively run node setup.js in the container console.) Then log in — pick the modules you want and invite your family.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Database and stored app data (uploads, documents).

paths.name: Backups
paths.description: Destination folder for scheduled and manual database backups.

paths.name: Modules
paths.description: Optional: drop-in folder for additional Yuvomi modules. Leave default if unused.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the Yuvomi web interface.

variables.name: SESSION_SECRET
variables.description: REQUIRED. A long random string used to sign sessions. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48

variables.name: DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY
variables.description: RECOMMENDED. Strong key to encrypt the database at rest (SQLCipher). Leave empty for unencrypted SQLite. Cannot be changed later without re-encrypting. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Affects scheduled backups and reminders.

variables.name: SESSION_SECURE
variables.description: Use 1 behind one reverse proxy (Caddy/nginx/Traefik), or 'loopback' for direct (no proxy) access.

variables.name: DB_PATH
variables.description: Path to the SQLite database inside the container. Keep default unless you know what you are doing.
